speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: ここのずっと向こうの街外れのお屋〓にねどこかのお〓さまが〓われてるって噂があってねぇ <PART> 亡くなったはずのディパンの姫じゃないかとか一時期いろいろと憶〓が〓んだんだけど <PART> 結局は誰も確かめられない内にお屋〓は崩れてしまったそうよ
original_en:
Rumor had it that a girl was hidden
in the estate outside of town. <PART>
---
Everyone had a theory <PART> ---- <PART> some said she
was the princess of Dipan, believed dead. <PART>
---
But I guess we'll never know, because
the place crumbled to the ground.

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: もし本当にディパンの姫だったら上手い所に隠れたよねぇ <PART> まさかこの国に居るなんて他の人は思わないじゃない？
original_en:
If it really was the princess of Dipan,
she picked a great hiding place. <PART>
---
Who would have ever thought
to look for her here?

original_jp: 〓が欲しいみたい…
original_en: Looks hungry...

original_jp: たくさん食べてね
original_en: Eat up!

original_jp: ごめんなさい…今 あげられる物は何も無いの
original_en:
I'm sorry...
I don't have any food for you.

original_jp: ありがとう 大切にするわね
original_en: Thank you. I'll put it to good use.

speaker: Matron
original_jp: 昔話だけどね 大陸のずっと〓の方に竜が住んでいたそうだよ <PART> 竜は人と〓するのを嫌い 神殿の奥〓で宝を守りながら〓っている…という話だったかねぇ
original_en:
There's an old tale about a dragon that
dwelled in the east of the continent. <PART>
---
The dragon hated humans and slept deep
within his palace, guarding a treasure.

speaker: Matron
original_jp: 昔話というのはね意外と本当の事が多いんだよ <PART> だから 竜のお話も本当かもしれないね
original_en:
You'd be surprised just how many
old tales turn out to be true. <PART>
---
Maybe that one's real, too.

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: 空が急に光ったかと思ったら家の〓が〓えちゃってねぇ <PART> 〓っこに〓まって 家から一歩も出ようとしないのよ
original_en:
The sky flashed for a second, and it
scared the fleas off of my dog! <PART>
---
He curled up in the corner, and now he
won't take one step out of the house.

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: 一体何があったって言うんだろうねぇ皆騒いでるし 動物は〓えてるし…
original_en:
What exactly was it? People are in
a frenzy, and pets are terrified!

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: 確かに ディパン王は罪をおかしたんだろうよだが名〓だったのも また事実じゃねえか？ <PART> 命を奪うまではしなくとも良かったろうに神の〓悲とは 何なのかねぇ
original_en:
The king of Dipan was indeed guilty of sin,
but was he not also a great leader? <PART>
---
His life could have been spared. It makes
me wonder whether the gods know mercy.

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: 今まで遠〓や小〓り合いばかりだったがディパン崩壊で戦が本格化しそうだな <PART> この国は どこへ向かおうとしているのかねぇ全ては神のみぞ知る…ってとこなのかね
original_en:
It's been campaigns and skirmishes until
now, but things will escalate with Dipan gone. <PART>
---
Where will Crell Monferaigne look next?
I suppose only the gods know...

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: ディパンが一〓で滅んじまったとか神様って本当に居たんだねぇ… <PART> 実は私 あまり信じてなかったんだよねでもこれからは 真面目に教会へ行くよ
original_en:
With Dipan being destroyed overnight,
I guess the gods really do exist. <PART>
---
I never really believed all that stuff,
but I'm going to chapel from now on!

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: 今までは 自分の目で見たものしか信じなかったけれど… <PART> 神が本当に居たのなら少し行いを〓めなくちゃならないねぇ
original_en:
I'd only believed things I'd seen
with my own two eyes, <PART>
---
but if the gods are for real,
I'll have to change my ways.

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: 家の〓ったら 色々と隠すのが〓味みたいでねたまに凄い物を持ってたりするのよ <PART> でも 〓を上げないと〓い主にすら中々見せてくれなくて… <PART> 他人なら〓更よ気が向いた時じゃないとダメみたい
original_en:
Our dog's always hiding stuff, the rascal.
He gets a hold of some incredible things! <PART>
---
But he doesn't show us, his family,
unless we give him a treat. <PART>
---
Even more so for strangers!
He has to be in the mood.

speaker: Dog
original_jp: わああ すごい！〓の言葉がわかるの？ 木ントに木ント？ <PART> 〓ね 人間とお話したかったのお話できたら楽しいだろうなあって思ってたんだ <PART> だからね お姉さんに良い事教えてあげるセラフィックゲートって知ってる？ <PART> 完全にこの世の法〓を無視した不思議の世界なんだよ <PART> だから その中で起こった事はこの世界とは関係ないんだよ
original_en:
Bow-wow-wow! Can you understand the words
coming out of my mouth? For real, for real? <PART>
---
I've always wanted to talk to a person!
I figured it might be interesting. <PART>
---
Let me make it worth your while, then.
Have you ever heard of Seraphic Gate? <PART>
---
It's a strange world that completely
defies the laws of our world. <PART>
---
For that reason, whatever happens there
has no bearing on this world.

speaker: Dog
original_jp: あ そうだ この間コレ〓ったの〓の宝物 お姉さんにあげるね
original_en:
Oh yeah, I picked this up the other day.
I'll let you have my precious find.

speaker: Dog
original_jp: セラフィックゲートの事はみんな知らないのご主人様にだって教えてないんだからね
original_en:
Nobody knows about Seraphic Gate.
I haven't even told my owners!
